fieldValues.title: An owner ruling given in a PR comment did not reach the decision record or the follow-up issue, so a done task sat in the ready queue
fieldValues.summary: Decision c16c70c1 (session 2026-10-27, option B) said srs-rust#1481 lands without the release.yml line and filed srs-rust#1495 to add it after a week. On 2026-10-28 17:32 the owner ruled in a PR #1481 comment to keep the line, and merged #1481 at 17:52 with arrangement-fixture in the release gate. On 2026-10-30 c16c70c1 still reads proposed with option B, #1495 is still labelled ready, and the 11:30 cycle report lists it as one of four workable issues.
evidence: srs-rust#1481 comment 2026-10-28T17:32:58Z (owner): 'Owner ruling on the release.yml change: keep it.' Merged 2026-10-28T17:52:30Z
srs-rust master 1055ef0f, .github/workflows/release.yml:428: arrangement-fixture in the corpus-conformance gate (from b833207a)
srs-rust#1495 open with ready + wg:third-party-ready on 2026-10-30; semanticops.com#31 wg-report 2026-10-30 counts it as workable
decision c16c70c1 in srs-programme master 4aaa41d: status proposed, still option B
fieldValues.body:
- The stop is at landing (work flow stage 7) and at recording (decision flow D5): the ruling lived only in a PR comment.
- Nothing links a PR-comment ruling back to the decision it revises, so neither the decision nor the issue it spawned was updated.
- Cost avoided this time: a builder would have opened a PR for work already on master.
